title: Schriever disc test flight in Prague

tellings.quote: Kammler recruited Rudolf Schriever, a German technician who claims to have worked on a disc-shaped craft in Prague that made its first test flight in February of 1945, climbing to 40,000 ft in 3 minutes.

plain: In February 1945, a disc-shaped craft built in Prague is said to have made its first test flight, climbing to 40,000 feet in three minutes. Michels says a German technician named Rudolf Schriever claimed to have worked on it after being recruited by a man named Hans Kammler. Michels tells it himself in an episode with the writer Nick Cook about antigravity, the idea of craft that cancel or beat gravity. If true, it would mean Nazi Germany had flying discs before anyone reported UFOs.
